title: Royal Plaza Trade Center

services.name: corporate event
services.desc: Located 35 miles west of Boston, Best Western Royal Plaza Hotel & Trade Center offers modern meeting and event space and well-appointed corporate lodging in Marlborough, MA. We have 22,000 square feet of flexible meeting space in our hotel, with 22 meeting and banquet rooms, and, if your event calls for even more space, we have another 47,500 square feet of space in our Trade Center and 14,950 square feet in our event tent. Whether you're planning a conference, corporate training or a board meeting, we have the space, amenities, and impeccable service you require for a flawless event. Guests in town for your event can enjoy exceptional rates on group lodging at Best Western Royal Plaza
